answer.reason: Several verses state what Dedan did in trade and what the LORD declared against it, beyond the summary's note that it was a region of Arabia.

clauses.english: traded with Tyre in precious clothes for chariots
clauses.quote: Dedan was thy merchant in precious clothes for chariots.

clauses.english: was warned to flee because the LORD would bring calamity upon it
clauses.quote: Flee ye, turn back, dwell deep, O inhabitants of Dedan

doubts: ISA 21:13, JER 25:23, EZK 25:13, EZK 27:15 and EZK 38:13 were left out as list entries, a repeat of the same judgment, or a minor detail.
The Dedan of EZK 25:13 and JER 49:8 may be linked to Edom, but the verses given do not settle where it lay.
